message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. Facts: Defendant Luo forged four car purchase invoice copies, used them as credit proof, in name of Jiao (already sentenced) to obtain a loan of 300,000 yuan from a rural commercial bank. Later repaid 20,000 and refinanced 280,000, then defaulted, causing direct economic loss of 280,000 yuan to bank.

This is fraud (诈骗) by means of falsifying documents to obtain loan. Also possibly "伪造金融票据罪"? But forging invoices is falsification of documents (伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章罪?) Actually forging purchase invoices is falsification of financial documents, used to obtain loan. The statutory offense likely "诈骗罪" (fraud) and "伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章罪" maybe not. The rule says: When the facts describe a defendant’s role in a scheme that withdraws money from victims’ bank or credit‑card accounts, classify under fraud (诈骗) and, if... But here it's loan fraud. So main crime: 诈骗罪. Also possibly "伪造金融票据罪"? The invoices are not financial instruments. Could be "伪造国家机关证件、印章罪"? No. So likely just 诈骗.

Thus output single crime: 诈骗. According to format: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>. JSON with final_answer.
